title: The wrong panel
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday. The laundromat owner reads the second digest at the counter. She laughs — at panel two, which isn't the joke. Wood, in the doorway, decides panel two is the joke now.

panels.composition: The laundromat. The rack by the door, the second digest in it. The OWNER in a cardigan at the counter, reading one, folding a towel with the other hand.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a laundromat with a small zine rack by the door and a woman in a cardigan at the counter reading a zine while folding a towel

panels.composition: Her laugh. At the page. Her thumb on panel two.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a woman laughing at a small comic page with her thumb resting on its second panel

panels.composition: WOOD in the doorway, seeing which panel. His face: it wasn't that one.

balloons.text: (thinks) Panel two. Panel two isn't the —

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man in a laundromat doorway watching a woman laugh at his comic with a puzzled expression

panels.composition: Wood at the counter. The owner looking up.

balloons.text: The dog one. With the — the face he makes.
You should do more of those.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a woman in a cardigan at a laundromat counter telling a young man which part of his comic she liked

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox

notes: The wrong panel is the right panel. The first reader.
